  **Real-World Data**
  [NLP-Enriched EHR Data Solutions][189] Large-scale, high-quality health data sets.
  **Real-World Evidence**
  [Real-World Evidence][190] Retrospective and prospective research by RWE experts.
  [Real-World Evidence Analytics Platform][191] SaaS application enabling efficient analysis of
  real-world data.
  **Point of Care Marketing**
  [Digital Health Media][192] Highly targeted brand awareness messaging in the EHR.*
* [Health Plans + Payers][193]
  [Health Plan Payers]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Health Plans + Payers overview][194]
  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.
* [Health IT Vendors][227]
  [Veradigm Network]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare IT Vendor Solutions overview][228]
  **Powered by the Network**
  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.
* [Insights][236]

  [Blog Posts][238] Read through our collection of valuable insights.
  [Videos][239] Watch our videos to learn more about our offerings.
  [Thought Leadership][240] Read the latest healthcare insights from our team of subject matter
  experts.
  [Podcasts][241] Listen to our podcasts to hear healthcare insights from our team of experts.
  [Webinars][242] Watch our webinars to learn more about how we are transforming health,
  insightfully.
  **Resources**
  [RWE Publications][243] Read through our RWE publications and learn how we help clients.
  [Clinical Data Registries][244] Explore our registry publications and learn how we help clients.
  [*Smart Medicine* Podcast][245] Thought-provoking podcast dedicated to understanding the
  intersection of care and innovation
  **Trending Topics**
  [Value-Based Care][246] Comprehensive guide to value-based care, including use cases, relevant
  blog articles, white papers and more.
  [Real-World Evidence][247] Complete overview of real-world evidence, why it’s important, and how
  it’s used in healthcare.
  [Real-World Data][248] Thorough review of what real-world healthcare data is, how it’s collected,
  and how it’s used across the healthcare spectrum.
  [Payer Provider Relationships Guide][249] Discover the impact of payer-provider relationships on
  healthcare. Learn how collaboration improves patient care and addresses challenges.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

# Thank You Dr. Rush!

Thank you Victor for all the amazing years you put into TDT grow. We and all your customers will
miss you!

[Exit to Stage Left][170]

# This Is An iCon

The iCon is a bespoke neuroscience system designed for your specific experimental needs.

[Are you ready for more?][171]

# High Throughput Behavior

The iPac is TDT’s flagship behavioral controller. Record up to 8 experiments simultaneously and
asynchronously all from a central interface.

[Productivity in Overdrive][172]

# Integrated Fiber Photometry + OptoStim

TDT’s Fiber Photometry systems are out-of-the-box solutions that easily configure to record multiple
fluorophores in multiple sites while time-locking behavioral and video data.

[A Shining Example of Quality][173]

# Legacy. Innovation. Committment

TDT builds turn-key hardware and software systems for neuroscience research. We are known worldwide
for high quality products, a concierge sales experience, and exceptional customer service.

# TDT is the Leading Provider of Neuroscience
# Hardware, Tools, and Software

 

TDT has been pioneering neuroscience research tools and software since 1988. We have a global
presence across five continents and are dedicated to leading and supporting an ever-growing and
diverse neuroscience community with our unmatched innovation.

TDT neuroscience equipment and software is versatile and flexible, and scales to support the current
and future goals of your research. Our customers realize increased long-term productivity and find
it easier to teach new lab members how to use our equipment. This means you spend more time
accomplishing grant benchmarks and publishing and less time trying to make things work.

Customers know what they are getting when they choose TDT. Are you ready to find out?

[Picture of an iConZ neuroscience system with modules for fiber photometry recording, video
tracking, EEG recordings, and analog + digital I/O.]

• Precise real-time hardware and intuitive software control
• All your data synchronized in one place
• Industry best 5-Year warranty
• Free lifetime technical support

**Our expert staff will help at every step to make sure you have exactly what you need to do the
research you want.**

## Frequently
## asked questions.

### Are digital flashcards effective?

Yes, digital flashcards can be much more effective than paper flashcards both because they are more
**convenient** (especially for large numbers of cards) and because they allow for more
**personalization** — using key cognitive science principles like active recall, metacognition, and
spaced repetition. ([See how it works][80])

### What is the best app for making flashcards?

**Brainscape**, of course! Not only does Brainscape provide the most flexible web and mobile
flashcard editor, import functionality, and AI-powered content creation, but it also provides the
most effective iOS and Android app for studying those flashcards and actually retaining the
knowledge.

### What is the most effective way to make flashcards?

The best flashcard creation technique is often to using a **combination of AI and manual curation**.
While AI alone can help you make large quantities of flashcards from source material very quickly,
it is still important to rigorously check, edit, prune, append, and rearrange the content to make it
more useful for your own studying. Deeply evaluating your flashcards' quality also helps the
knowledge stick even before you begin studying those flashcards!

### Why is Brainscape the world's most effective study platform?

While other study apps are either complex to use and/or tailored toward quick cramming sessions,
Brainscape is optimized for **long-term, high-stakes learning pursuits**. Our platform applies
decades of cognitive science research to help you learn faster, stay motivated, and develop stronger
study habits so you can reach your goals more ***efficiently***.

### What is the difference between Brainscape vs Quizlet?

Quizlet's primary unit of content is "terms and definitions". This limitation allows Quizlet to
create a variety of "game" modes that make it "fun" to study small sets of basic vocab words.
Brainscape, in contrast, supports a more flexible flashcard format and trusts the user (not the
game) to determine their own confidence in each item. This allows Brainscape to create a more
holistic, curricular path toward long-term mastery of subjects like foreign languages, medical
school courses, and major professional certifications — in addition to a marketplace of trustworthy
"certified" content made by publishers. ([See Brainscape vs Quizlet][81])

### What is the difference between Brainscape vs Anki?

As an open source platform, Anki is very flexible and customizable. But it also has a steep learning
curve and requires many downloads, plug-ins, and tutorials to get started. Brainscape is a more
**user-friendly**, cloud-based, **collaborative** study app that is easy to set up in seconds —
either on your own or with a whole class or organization. Brainscape's web & mobile platform uses AI
to not only help create flashcards more effectively, but also to help you study with a **more
effective spaced repetition algorithm**, progress statistics, and habit-building features to keep
you motivated. Brainscape also offers "certified" decks created by publishers and other highly
curated partners. ([See Brainscape vs Anki][82])

### Is Brainscape free?

Yes! Brainscape makes it **free** to make or import unlimited flashcards, share flashcards with
peers or students, study with spaced repetition, try our AI features, and set custom study reminders
to help improve your study habits. You only need to upgrade if you need more advanced features like
unlimited AI-powered flashcard creation, access to certified content, or organization-wide features
like private content and advanced stats. ([See Pricing][83])

### How can I share my Brainscape flashcards with others?

Once you've created a "class" in Brainscape (i.e. a place to host your decks), you can easily
generate a free link to share with anyone you want. People accessing your shared link will also have
free and complete access to your flashcards. You can also make your class fully private, where
people can only access it if you invite them directly via email. Finally, you also have the option
to share a "paid" link if you want to sell your flashcards, and you can even lease access codes from
Brainscape to resell on your own website. ([How to sell my flashcards online][84])

## Frequently
## asked questions.

### Are digital flashcards effective?

Yes, digital flashcards can be much more effective than paper flashcards both because they are more
**convenient** (especially for large numbers of cards) and because they allow for more
**personalization** — using key cognitive science principles like active recall, metacognition, and
spaced repetition. ([See how it works][80])

### What is the best app for making flashcards?

**Brainscape**, of course! Not only does Brainscape provide the most flexible web and mobile
flashcard editor, import functionality, and AI-powered content creation, but it also provides the
most effective iOS and Android app for studying those flashcards and actually retaining the
knowledge.

### What is the most effective way to make flashcards?

The best flashcard creation technique is often to using a **combination of AI and manual curation**.
While AI alone can help you make large quantities of flashcards from source material very quickly,
it is still important to rigorously check, edit, prune, append, and rearrange the content to make it
more useful for your own studying. Deeply evaluating your flashcards' quality also helps the
knowledge stick even before you begin studying those flashcards!

### Why is Brainscape the world's most effective study platform?

While other study apps are either complex to use and/or tailored toward quick cramming sessions,
Brainscape is optimized for **long-term, high-stakes learning pursuits**. Our platform applies
decades of cognitive science research to help you learn faster, stay motivated, and develop stronger
study habits so you can reach your goals more ***efficiently***.

### What is the difference between Brainscape vs Quizlet?

Quizlet's primary unit of content is "terms and definitions". This limitation allows Quizlet to
create a variety of "game" modes that make it "fun" to study small sets of basic vocab words.
Brainscape, in contrast, supports a more flexible flashcard format and trusts the user (not the
game) to determine their own confidence in each item. This allows Brainscape to create a more
holistic, curricular path toward long-term mastery of subjects like foreign languages, medical
school courses, and major professional certifications — in addition to a marketplace of trustworthy
"certified" content made by publishers. ([See Brainscape vs Quizlet][81])

### What is the difference between Brainscape vs Anki?

As an open source platform, Anki is very flexible and customizable. But it also has a steep learning
curve and requires many downloads, plug-ins, and tutorials to get started. Brainscape is a more
**user-friendly**, cloud-based, **collaborative** study app that is easy to set up in seconds —
either on your own or with a whole class or organization. Brainscape's web & mobile platform uses AI
to not only help create flashcards more effectively, but also to help you study with a **more
effective spaced repetition algorithm**, progress statistics, and habit-building features to keep
you motivated. Brainscape also offers "certified" decks created by publishers and other highly
curated partners. ([See Brainscape vs Anki][82])

### Is Brainscape free?

Yes! Brainscape makes it **free** to make or import unlimited flashcards, share flashcards with
peers or students, study with spaced repetition, try our AI features, and set custom study reminders
to help improve your study habits. You only need to upgrade if you need more advanced features like
unlimited AI-powered flashcard creation, access to certified content, or organization-wide features
like private content and advanced stats. ([See Pricing][83])

### How can I share my Brainscape flashcards with others?

Once you've created a "class" in Brainscape (i.e. a place to host your decks), you can easily
generate a free link to share with anyone you want. People accessing your shared link will also have
free and complete access to your flashcards. You can also make your class fully private, where
people can only access it if you invite them directly via email. Finally, you also have the option
to share a "paid" link if you want to sell your flashcards, and you can even lease access codes from
Brainscape to resell on your own website. ([How to sell my flashcards online][84])

Cardiac-Devices.com is a site supported by [Association Initiative Medicale][41], an non-govermental
organization (NGO) based in France. Cardiac-Devices.com is intended to inventory of all devices used
in Cardiology, in order to ease the cardiologist’s task of choosing which device is pertinent to
which disease or setting. **We highly encourage the Industry to send us the latest news regarding
cardiac devices.** The site is free, there is no payment for the presentation of the devices. The
devices are reviewed by cardiologists.

#### Society of Cardiology!][42]

medicine to chart the way forward. This is your chance to be at the forefront of the digital health
revolution. Key topics on the agenda include the future of remote monitoring, cybersecurity, data
privacy, clinical decision support (including AI), workflow management, digital literacy and much
more. For more info access [this link][43].

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you
  don't read the same headline 20 times.
* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you
  don't read the same headline 20 times.
* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust

hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

electrophysiology devices for research. The portfolio is rounded off by the sale of equipment for electrophysiology and imaging. Extensive consulting and comprehensive product support, even long after the purchase of the electrophysiology devices, are part of the brand essence of npi electronic. [ ][136] #### [ Products and Services ][137] Electrophysiology and imaging devices and accessories for all sectors of modern research, including development of new measurement processes, planning and equipping of complete laboratories, custom specific equipping of measurement rigs, as well as installation and training.
Our product range includes: Electrophysiology amplifiers, High precision drug application systems, Micropositioners, Microscopes and Optics, Temperature controllers, Stimulators
Perfusion systems, Vibrating microtomes, Surgical equipment, Laboratory supplies, ...and everything else that is necessary for electrophysiology and imaging. Just ask us! [ ][138] #### [ Applications ][139] Our electrophysiology devices combine modern analog electronics, control theory and state-of-the-art software and offer speed, precision and superior noise performance with designs that can adapt and expand.
We supply devices and services for various applications: Patch Clamp measurements, Extracellular recordings, Intracellular measurements, In-vivo electrophysiology, Imaging, Neurosurgery for in-vivo measurements, Neurochemistry, Two electrode voltage clamp, Oocyte recordings, Voltametry / Amperometry, Cardiac electrophysiology, Stroke research, ... and many more fields and applications. Just ask us!

[ ][136] #### [ Products and Services ][137] Electrophysiology and imaging devices and accessories for all sectors of modern research, including development of new measurement processes, planning and equipping of complete laboratories, custom specific equipping of measurement rigs, as well as installation and training.
Our product range includes: Electrophysiology amplifiers, High precision drug application systems, Micropositioners, Microscopes and Optics, Temperature controllers, Stimulators
Perfusion systems, Vibrating microtomes, Surgical equipment, Laboratory supplies, ...and everything else that is necessary for electrophysiology and imaging. Just ask us! [ ][138] #### [ Applications ][139] Our electrophysiology devices combine modern analog electronics, control theory and state-of-the-art software and offer speed, precision and superior noise performance with designs that can adapt and expand.
We supply devices and services for various applications: Patch Clamp measurements, Extracellular recordings, Intracellular measurements, In-vivo electrophysiology, Imaging, Neurosurgery for in-vivo measurements, Neurochemistry, Two electrode voltage clamp, Oocyte recordings, Voltametry / Amperometry, Cardiac electrophysiology, Stroke research, ... and many more fields and applications. Just ask us!

## For business professionals who want a serious competitive advantage

Owler Pro gives you access to premium features that keep your business in the loop about relevant
company, competitor, and industry news – so you can find qualified leads, improve your outreach, and
build better relationships with your customers.

**Follow an unlimited amount of companies relevant to your business needs**

**Discover new accounts, industry trends, and more**

## For people who want an easier way to follow up to 5 companies that matter to them

Join Owler’s active community of 5 million+ business professionals and get exclusive insights about
competitors, prospects, and market updates that are only available to Owler users – so you can
ensure you stay ahead of the competition.

**Find detailed company information**

**Discover your closest competitors**

**Get real-time alerts and daily emails about relevant company and market news**

[ Learn about Owler Community ][64]

## What makes Owler different?

Discover your direct and indirect competitors with Owler's exclusive competitor graph.

Search accurate private and public company data for over 20 million companies.

Create targeted lists to get daily, personalized emails and alerts about news and companies that
matter to you.

Access detailed company data, including revenue, employee count, funding history, acquisitions,
news, and more.

Filter Owler’s entire database by revenue, sector, location, employee count, and public/private
company status.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]

to automate manufacturing.

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## The Scientifica Difference

###### Core Values

As a Scientifica team, we defined what our core values are - quality, customer focus, passion,
teamwork, innovation, flexibility and trust. These values are deep-rooted and guide us in everything
we do.

###### People

Our professional team will happily support you in every step of your scientific journey, with a high
level of expertise and experience.

###### Versatile

The versatility of our team, the products we design and support we offer means you can be confident
that your needs will be met, now and in the future.

###### Quality

We are internationally recognised and certified for our superior product design, reliability, and
service and support. Everything we do is achieved with excellence.

## Testimonials

"My entire experience with Scientifica has been exceptional. From my initial inquiry through to
installation, everyone I interacted with was quick to respond to my questions and worked with me to
ensure my system was exactly what I needed for my research program. I will highly recommend
Scientifica to my colleagues, and I’m excited to continue working with them in the future".

Dr Sam Centanni
Wake Forest University School of Medicine

"Scientifica has exceeded my expectations with their top-notch products and impeccable service.
Their commitment to supplying high-quality equipment for patch clamp electrophysiology setups is
unmatched. From start to finish, the installation process was seamless, thanks to their competent
and efficient team. I highly recommend Scientifica to anyone in need of reliable tools and excellent
service."

Dr Marco Bocchio
University of Durham

“ I had an outstanding experience with Scientifica.…We acquired a complete ephys system and got it
set up and installed with them together. But this is not where Scientifica’s services ended. They
are clearly not just interested in selling, but to build long lasting customer relationships, with
time-to-time site visits, and availability for troubleshooting of specific questions we had....their
experts in house are always happy to help. The customer, and their customer’s satisfaction is
clearly part of their company philosophy.”

Dr Janin Lautenschläger
CIMR, University of Cambridge

"The SliceScope Pro 6000 is the workhorse of my lab, adapting to all of my various experimental
needs. The integrated and lower mounts allow for easy access of electrodes and stimtrodes to brain
slices in the recording chamber and working space around the rig allowing for a comfortable
recording experience. If I ever have issues, Scientifica is very responsive to any questions or
potential repairs. Love my rig"

Dr Andrew Hardaway
University of Alabama at Birmingham

"Our research group has used the Scientifica PatchStar for many years and find it to be reliable,
easy and intuitive to use for visually guided patch clamp. It gives us the fine control we need for
patching multiple cells and maintaining those seals over long recordings."

Hannah Warming
University of Southampton

"Scientifica couples high-precision, reliable instrumentation with world-class customer service.
What could be better?"

Dr Brian Mathur
University of Maryland, Baltimore

# **VRAI MEDICAL TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS**

Over the past few years, the MedTech industry has witnessed significant growth and development. An
aging population, rising burden of chronic diseases and increased trust in medical devices by
clinicians and consumers have resulted in greater alliances between pharmaceutical companies and the
MedTech sector. Despite these challenges, medical device companies will benefit from several
important market drivers:
* Growth in emerging markets
* Higher prices for advanced, innovative devices
* Rising revenues and debt reduction at U.S. hospitals
* Mergers and acquisitions that enhance efficiencies
* The need for non-pharmaceutical methods to avoid drug side effects

**Given these factors, growth prospects for medical devices remain strong.**

[ Learn more ][14]
 
 
 
 

## AT **VRAI MEDICAL WE ARE DEDICATED TO THE EVOLUTION OF HEALTHCARE. **

### through simplified medical devices that provide physicians tools to diagnose and treat various
### medical conditions - WE CAN provide patients a better understanding of their disease state with
### direct engagement in their own healthcare management!

### One of the biggest market trends has been the rise of artificial intelligence (AI). MedTech
### companies are investing heavily in the R&D of AI-based technologies, such as cloud-based
### software and healthcare applications. These technologies have the potential to change the face
### of the MedTech market, aiding clinical decision-making and early diagnosis of disease. AI-based
### technologies enable self-testing by patients and point-of-care (POC) diagnosis, resulting in
### fewer visits to hospitals and individualized treatment. It’s not without its challenges,
### however, as cybersecurity issues have negatively impacted progress of AI development.

[ VRAI CARDIAC DEVICES ][15]
 
 

## PRIVACY + SECURITY

VRAI Medical is committed to our users privacy and security. Because the healthcare field deals with
sensitive information, it is a prime target for hackers - learn how we are committed to protecting
our data and patients confidentiality.

[ Learn more ][16]

# ABOUT

[590714699115 2.JPG]
 
 

## VRAI MEDICAL

[006.JPG]

VRAI Medical Technology was founded by Dr TJ TRAD. Dr Trad completed his undergraduate studies in
biochemistry, his masters degree in biomedical sciences, and medical degree from Oklahoma State
University. Dr Trad went on to finish his Residency in Internal Medicine and Fellowship in Invasive
Cardiology which he carries dual board certifications from. He is the founder of [CURA for the
world,][17] a non-profit organization with free medical clinics around the world. Dr Trad is
passionate about creating medical technologies that further assist physicians in diagnoses and that
will remotely enable physician - patient and physician to physician communication.

Dr Trad was the Chief Medical Officer for [CURA TeleHealth][18], a Telemedicine platform and AI
program that links general practitioners, and specialists to patients in a streamlined approach from
2018-2021.

Dr Trad also runs a concierge private practice in cardiology and internal medicine in Tulsa,
Oklahoma; [Tulsa cardiology clinic. ][19]

VRAI Medical Technology will start its journey with CardioFLŌ, a noninvasive fluid monitoring device
that guides patients with heart failure and other fluid retaining ailments towards euvolemic states.
